audience: Adventure Works' COO and CIO, who need to judge whether {device} can improve field sales rep productivity while keeping confidential customer data safe.
objective: Secure approval for a 2-week pilot with 10 field sales reps to test {device} in real-world conditions.
context: Adventure Works has 120 field sales reps who write approximately 15 customer visit summaries per week, with each summary taking about 20 minutes to complete. The reps work from customer sites using guest Wi-Fi networks and handle confidential pricing sheets that require secure handling. They already use Microsoft 365 Copilot in their daily workflow. The company is considering a pilot program to evaluate a local AI lane on the device for field sales productivity.
facts: Adventure Works has 120 field sales reps.
Each rep writes about 15 customer visit summaries per week.
Each summary takes approximately 20 minutes to complete.
Reps often work from customer sites with guest Wi-Fi.
The pilot scope is 2 weeks with 10 reps.
guardrails: Do not claim specific productivity improvements or time savings.
Do not mention any pricing information.
Do not reference any other Microsoft products or services beyond Copilot.
Do not make claims about the pilot's success without actual results.
Use only numbers from the fact sheet; label any estimate as an estimate to validate.
Do not claim local AI replaces Microsoft 365 Copilot or any cloud subscription.
Do not claim air-gapped, certified offline or security certification; say disconnected use is validated in the pilot.
